passages.excerpt: strikes by invoking the victim's own payment and disbursement APIs

sources.limitations: Agency-reported affected Indian financial entities; not evidence of a Canadian/Ardent-client incident, universal AI autonomy, frequency or losses.

sources.title: CIAD-2026-0046

passages.excerpt: Validate every payout against sanctioned/approved records

sources.limitations: Recommendations apply to the described campaign; no guarantee or claim that every system has the weakness.

claims.text: CERT-In reports an AI-assisted campaign targeting Indian financial entities through their payment interfaces.

The earlier advisory describes stolen credentials enabling direct payment calls that bypass application checks, and recommends binding transaction stages and validating payouts against approved records.
An approval screen alone does not establish that authorization is enforced at the point of transfer.
Leaders should trace one approved payment from decision to execution, checking what permission the final transfer accepts.
